Acorn
=====

Upstream:   https://github.com/acornjs/acorn
Package:    https://www.npmjs.com/package/acorn
Version:    8.17.0
Source URL: https://registry.npmjs.org/acorn/-/acorn-8.17.0.tgz
License:    MIT (see LICENSE)

Why vendored
------------
Store and web packages reject JavaScript module loads that cannot pass through
peerd's host resolver. This is a security boundary, so it needs a grammar-correct
parser rather than a handwritten token scanner. Acorn is already pinned through
the repository's development dependency graph. The extension imports this copy
directly because extension runtime code cannot depend on npm.

Files committed
---------------
  acorn.mjs  dist/acorn.mjs from the published package, byte-identical
  LICENSE    LICENSE from the published package, byte-identical

SHA-256
-------
  acorn.mjs  1cbcbf252a5800e496dc505c706f309a9dd4e1789392e12963c77ae9497ff6f7
  LICENSE    76a876cf886ff9be2a8b5e2e86514fed06223c8c9f0c1e9ee9606e93841e00b7

Modification
------------
None.

Update procedure
----------------
1. Download the published package for the new version.
2. Copy dist/acorn.mjs and LICENSE without modification.
3. Update the version and hashes above.
4. Run `bun packaging/check-vendor.ts --write`.
